According to XRD charts, all three alloys had a single-phase bcc structure (Fig. 1a). The Al alloying shifted Bragg's peaks to smaller 2θ values, indicating a gradual increase in the lattice parameter. The latter enlarged from 0.3239 ± 0.0001 nm in the Nb40Ti40V20 alloy to 0.3258 ± 0.0001 nm in the Al20Nb40Ti40 alloy.
